updatedNote: Sunday refresh from Diablo: Saturday cleared. Last day for both the North Florida Fair and Cirque Du Luxe, FSU women host the Gators at 2, and the night belongs to Whose Live Anyway? at Ruby Diamond or the Van Halen tribute at The Moon. Cold snap still in play, so check event pages before heading out.

events.title: Whose Live Anyway?
events.venue: Ruby Diamond Concert Hall, 222 S Copeland St
events.hook: Ryan Stiles, Greg Proops, Jeff B. Davis and Joel Murray improvising off audience suggestions. From $59.

events.title: JUMP: America's Van Halen Experience
events.hook: David Lee Roth era Van Halen tribute, all guitar solos and big rock classics.

events.title: North Florida Fair (final day)
events.venue: North Florida Fairgrounds, 441 E Paul Russell Rd
events.hook: Last call for fair food, rides, and livestock barns before the 2026 fair closes.

events.title: Cirque Du Luxe (final day)
events.venue: Big Top at Governor's Square Mall, 1500 Apalachee Pkwy
events.hook: Final two shows of the touring big-top circus. $22-$38.

events.title: FSU vs. Florida Women's Basketball
events.venue: Donald L. Tucker Civic Center, 505 W Pensacola St
events.hook: Sunshine State rivalry: the Seminoles host the Gators.

events.title: Sunday at The Hub: The Charlie Brown Band
events.venue: The Hub at Feather Oaks, 6500 Miccosukee Rd
events.hook: Outdoor hangout with a live band, Rustic Grub food, and NFL on the TVs.

events.title: The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time
events.hook: Acclaimed play about Christopher's neighborhood mystery and what it uncovers about his family.

events.title: Coriolanus (final performance)
events.venue: FSU Lab Theatre, 502 S Copeland St
events.hook: Last chance for FSU's take on Shakespeare's political tragedy. $10 students.

events.title: A Christmas Carol (Young Actors Theatre)
events.hook: Menken and Ahrens musical version of the Dickens classic.

events.title: Beethoven's Musical Playground
events.venue: Opperman Music Hall, 114 N Copeland St
events.hook: Family concert with musical jokes, the Eyeglasses Duo, and a world premiere. RSVP required.

events.title: Guest Artist Recital: Ryan Gardner, trumpet
events.venue: Longmire Recital Hall, 600 W College Ave
events.hook: Afternoon trumpet recital at the FSU College of Music.

events.title: Move, Nourish & Give 5K
events.hook: FSU Food as Medicine 5K that helps fill Thanksgiving tables. $10 to run.
